s0_problem: Gurdev is seventy-eight. She lives with early memory loss in Patiala, and her grandson Aman lives in London. She asks the same questions many times a day, and when her memory changes, her family often notices too late. Recollect is an Alexa Plus companion, for her and for them.
s1_daily: Everything you see is real: a simulator calling Recollect's live server on AWS, with Amazon Bedrock choosing the tools. We type instead of speaking. Gurdev asks about her tablet, and the answer comes from today's log, in fixed wording, never advice. Asking who Aman is brings up a who's-who card. And when she asks where Aman is, three times, she hears exactly the same calm answer. Never, you already asked.
s2_memory: Now she tells a story about the first radio in the house. Recollect keeps her exact words. In the background, a Strands agent on Bedrock AgentCore finds the people, places and things, and her memory graph grows within seconds. Later, Aman asks how Grandma came to Patiala, and hears her own words, with the date she said them. When nothing is saved, Recollect says so. It never invents a memory.
s3_evening: At five in the evening, when confusion often gets worse, Recollect turns on the lights, plays familiar music, keeps every reply to one short sentence, and offers something calming from her profile.
s4_photo: Once a week, at a calm time of day, she is shown the same family photo. There is no right answer. Her description is saved as a comparable sample of her speech.
s5_family: Her family page compares her speech only with her own earlier speech. This history is simulated for the demo. Only a change that lasts four weeks, on two or more markers, reaches the family: a gentle note, and a printable report for her doctor. It never diagnoses. And the This is me page tells carers what matters to her.
s6_engineering: Under the hood, every tool answers in milliseconds, well inside the Alexa Plus budget, measured on the live deployment. Our grounding test quotes the right story for every answerable question, says nothing is saved for every other one, and invents nothing.
s7_close: Change tracking starts only when Gurdev and her family both agree, and she can stop it just by asking. Recollect keeps her story in her own words, keeps her days calm, and gives her family an early, honest signal. Everyone you have seen is fictional.
